title: Recent payments and earlier credits in the waived amount of a hardship waiver: Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
A hardship waiver on the Urology and Continence Supply Program is worked on a waived amount. What is taken from that amount depends on what the customer has recently paid, or what is already credited.

For a hardship waiver this policy handles, and only for such a waiver, the waived amount is counted by this policy's open-amount deduction, which sets the customer's recent payments against the waived amount first; for every other purpose a payment is still applied to the oldest unpaid posting first.

## Open-amount rule

1. **Recent payments.** When the customer has payments posted on the program within the last 3 calendar months, those payments are taken from the waived amount, set against it first.
2. **Earlier adjustment.** When there are no such payments, and a balance adjustment already stands against the named posting, that adjustment is taken from the waived amount.
3. **Otherwise** nothing is taken.

The named posting is the posting named on the program's approved hardship application with the latest received date. A payment is within the last 3 calendar months when it is posted fewer than 3 whole calendar months before the waiver date.

## Input, judgement and outcome (hypothetical)

| Payments in the last 3 months | Adjustment already against the named posting | Taken from the waived amount |
|---|---|---|
| 25.00 USD and 15.00 USD | any | 40.00 USD |
| none | 10.00 USD | 10.00 USD |
| none | none | nothing |
